Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 35 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Rohan - 12 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
4. Sharda - 72 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Neeta, Rohan and Sharda stand near him.]

Neeta: "Mother, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh points at the sky.]

Sharda: "Well done!"

[Flower petals rain down on Rishabh.]

Neeta: "And then?"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Rishabh (excited): "That was fun!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Rohan (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Rishabh trips over a stone and falls.]

Neeta: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The garden - Day

Neeta: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh waters the plants.]

Rishabh: "That's easy."

[Rishabh chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Rishabh: "I really enjoyed today."
